reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Janelle Fellone
reviews.text: I can't say enough about the service we received. Donnie went above and beyond to fix a difficult plumbing/drain problem at my elderly parent's home. He was a pleasure to work with and I appreciated is level of professionalism and advice. I also appreciated the communication confirming appointment times, estimated time of arrival and invoicing receipt. I would use this company again.

reviews.author: Chris King
reviews.text: Great service, very fast and efficient. Got a call they had a cancellation and Cody came out right away and was done within the hour. Will definitely use for any future plumbing jobs!

reviews.author: Annieg
reviews.text: After wasting just about a month with another local plumbing company, we would like to thank Dickson Plumbing and their employee, Cody M., for their quick service and excellent repair to our shower faucet! We will always call Dickson Plumbing in the future! Great Job!

reviews.author: Linda
reviews.text: Nothing but good things to say about this company. They did amazing plumbing work, gas work, and had great communication throughout the whole process. So thankful I found them.

reviews.author: Charles Wright
reviews.text: I appreciate your excellent service and want to thank you for your patience with me paying at the rate that I could afford. Thank you again and I will use your service in the future !!

reviews.author: Dave T
reviews.text: Always great service and an excellent job. Cody went above and beyond to install multiple items in our home.

reviews.author: Enver Alam
reviews.text: Arrived on time. Very friendly and courteous. Got my clogged kitchen sink fixed in less than an hour. Extremely satisfied with the service. Definitely could call them in the future if anything else goes wrong.

reviews.author: Curt Barnes
reviews.text: I read the reviews before calling Dickson for repairs I needed. I was set up with a time a tech would be by, tech showed up could NOT find a leak on either of the toilets that I requested service on replaced a $5 flapper and charged me $165 ..... SMH...and now three days later the toilet is still running

reviews.author: Mr Walton
reviews.text: Service technician was on time, diagnosed the problem went to get the necessary parts and was done in no time. A plumbing issue is never fun, but when you can get it repaired timely, saves you money in the end. Thank you, Donnie/Dickson Plumbing.

reviews.author: Ron Hughes
reviews.text: Richard did a great job installing a new water heater for us. He was friendly and professional. After we called in the morning, he arrived a few hours later. Kudos ! (South Mills)

reviews.author: Thomas Eskew
reviews.text: The Work was outstanding. The job required them to remove sheet rock to access the pipes. They replaced the spigot, installed an access panel and were done in about an hour. The work appears flawless.

reviews.author: Lesa Douglas
reviews.text: I am pleased. Mr Richard was very polite and professional. He understood what he was doing and he explained well. I would recommend Dickson Plumbing to anyone who is in need of proper plumbing work. The cost is a little high for me, however I am satisfied. Mr Richard works very organized and tidy. He is also well mannered. Thank you

reviews.author: Virginia Kincaid
reviews.text: Cleanest, most professional job we’ve ever seen done. Installers were great and very knowledgeable of their product. Very pleased with it all!

reviews.author: Ryan Smith
reviews.text: Dickson plumbing did an awesome job hooking up the gas to my Hayward Pool heater! I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tammi Middleton
reviews.text: Friendly. Needed two toilets set and was very, very expensive. Should have requested a quote prior but had no idea it would cost $600.00 for 1 hours worth of work.

reviews.author: Amanda Pless
reviews.text: Thank you so much for all of your help!!! Mr. Dickson was extremely responsive to my call and arrived at my home in Elizabeth City 45 minutes after I called him. Once he determined there may be a collapsed main on the city’s side of the line he waited with me until the city arrived to investigate from 5 to 7 pm. I will definitely be using him for many future plumbing projects as I renovate my older home. Very nice and extremely professional!

reviews.author: Bob M
reviews.text: Very quick service. Excellent communication on arrival time. Richard arrived on time and quickly completed the work. Very reasonable cost. I will.be recommending Richard to friends.

reviews.author: Sean Miller
reviews.text: They were on time, troubleshot and completed the repair quickly, and were extremely professional. After an improper installation (by another company) caused my water heater to stop working, they had it up and running in 20 minutes. I’d recommend Dickson to anyone and will be using them in the future.

reviews.author: Dr. Anne Marie Radke
reviews.text: Richard always does an amazing job for me. Just removed a corroded hose pipe on the outside of my condo with no mess or damage. Quality service, great manners, quality work, quality company. A+ He’s still the quiet rock star of plumbers-

reviews.author: Statfan
reviews.text: This is my third review of Dickson Plumbing, and again, had a great experience. Richard and Sam arrived first thing in the morning to fix water seepage at a connection on my newly installed HALO Water Treatment System. I reached out to them on Thursday evening, December 22nd, and they arrived the next morning to complete my repair. The seepage issue was caused by a pinched o-ring, which they replaced. As usual, their service is top notch, always responsive to my questions, professional and humble. They leave their work area clean and tidy. Thank you again for the great service!

reviews.author: Nekoletta Brown
reviews.text: I needed gas line hooked up to outside grill. Rich is very personable and on time. He knows his business very well he's honest and has fair pricing. Any further plumbing needs I have will be done by Rich!

reviews.author: S Smith
reviews.text: Dickson Plumbing was professional, knowledgeable, and was on time. He went above and beyond. Not only did he jet the lines like I had hired him for, but he also helped me figure out what was going on with our plumbing. Because of that, I am now able to continue to the next steps in fixing the problem. Thank you!

reviews.author: Rich Dickson
reviews.text: Inspected the drain field using a camera through all the lines. Found one place where the line had collapsed. Pinpointed exactly where the problem was so we could dig it up and make the repair without searching for it. They used the hydro jetter to clean all the lines and did a great job! excellent service with all the technology to figure out what the issues are quickly. I will definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Paula Ellis
reviews.text: Ryan came to our house. He was very professional and polite.he went the extra mile to fix our plumbing issues on our brand new house.when He was finished made sure we were happy and even petted our dog. Thanks Ryan

reviews.author: Shawntel Kuhnemund
reviews.text: Professional and courtesy. Handled all of the leg work that was needed to check our warranty on our water heater, and delivery. Then installed as quickly as possible.

reviews.author: Johnny jones
reviews.text: I appreciate the responsiveness and professionalism that Dickson Plumbing provided. Mr. Dickson took out the time to explain my situation and how to prevent in the future. Dickson Plumbing was friendly and very informative. The work was professional and superior. Recommend them to anyone in the Elizabeth City area.

reviews.author: Shawn Santini
reviews.text: Immaculate work. Very knowledgeable. The most professional plumber I have ever worked with. Was always on time!! Has my highest recommendation!! I will be using this company again for any plumbing needs I have in the future

reviews.author: Aimee Decoskey
reviews.text: Our previous contractor plumbed the kitchen sink during an addition to our house; we continued to have leaking from the P-trap nut that could not be controlled. Dickson came to service and explained that it was mechanically incorrect and missing some elements. He had to replumb and add a vent to it which involved opening the wall. I also have 3 external spigots that were in disrepair (one had a split in the stem). He walked us through each of the repairs and explained everything as he went. He was punctual, professional, and polite. Great experience and customer service. We have already booked our next service job and will be using him for our 2 rentals as well!

reviews.author: Christie Figueroa
reviews.text: Called Dickson’s due to a water leak and they were out within 45 minutes!! Great service and so kind. Thank you!

reviews.author: Kelli Hobbs
reviews.text: Had the BEST emergency assistance from Richard when a pipe under the house burst and we had no water. He came right over and explained in detail what happened and why and then had it fixed in no time. very knowledgeable and helpful. Thank you so much for getting us back up and running so quick, Richard! Kylie

reviews.author: liesl
reviews.text: This was the only company in town that I could manage to get to my house after a lot of attempts… several gave me dates to show up and and just didn’t, never called back, couldn’t even schedule, etc. The process of scheduling with Dickson was pleasant and about a week out. I was not in town when the work was done, I had our roommate let them in. Richard Dickson showed up early, with appropriate notice, and very promptly quoted us over the phone and handled the situation on the spot for an affordable cost. We waited the recommended time to use our bathroom, and there was still a minor leak. They came back the next morning and found that our shower panel needed replacing as well, and explained how to go forward with the process. We will hire them again.

reviews.author: ASLTA President
reviews.text: Richard Dickson is definitely and highly recommended for any type of plumbing repairs. He communicates very clearly and efficiently with us via all texting and answering questions.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Reid
reviews.text: Mr. Dickson and his helper were friendly and courteous. They handled a difficult repair with a creative, minimally intrusive solution. They cleaned up after themselves beautifully! I will definitely recommend them to my friends.

reviews.author: Ethan Cason
reviews.text: Our pipes were old quest from 1994 when our house was built. We had about 20 shark bites under the house and constant small leaks. The pump always cut on. I called Dickson Plumbing and they put me on the schedule. Mr. Dickson came out and was top notch. No other way to put it. He replaced all of our plumbing from the fixtures to the pump. My wife was home with our three kids both days he worked. One of our kids is under a year and needed naps. Mr. Dickson not only understood, but he was quiet and gave my wife plenty of notice of when he would need to make noise. I feel bad that he moved a lot of our junk around to get to the pipes, and he cleaned up everything. Spotless. We plan to do a diy remodel on our master bathroom and shower this fall and I told him we didn't need new faucets in there (the one we had didn't work) We have been using our kids bathroom. He went ahead and put new fixtures in our bathroom free of charge. He said "you never know what may happen and if you can't do the diy remodel soon I wanted to make sure you weren't stuck using your kids bathroom." Totally unexpected but we are so appreciative. I'm going to have him come back soon and replace our pump. I won't even bother getting other quotes. We bought our house as a foreclosure 5 years ago and while we have done a lot of diy remodeling some things I just can't do. Of all the private businesses we have had out here, Dickson Plumbing is at the top!

reviews.author: Tamara Benjamin
reviews.text: Mr. Dickson was perfessional from our initial conversation until all of our plumbing needs were taken care of. If you are looking for a honest, reliable, hardworking plumber give him a call you will not be disappointed! Highly recommended and will definitely use him again if we run into anymore plumbing issues!

reviews.author: Dan Stickel
reviews.text: Was very professional and told us what his plan was. Was up front about all issues with hot water heaters. Highly recommend his services. Will definitely have him come back for any other issues we have.

reviews.author: Duane
reviews.text: Had a busted pipe in the crawl space, called Dickson at 5:30 PM when most other plumbers are closed. I was surprised when Richard picked up and was here within 15 minutes! He got the problem resolved within half an hour and at a fair price. By far the best experience I’ve had with a service technician since I moved here 3 months ago.

reviews.author: Sydma Hatzopoulos
reviews.text: Responded to my phone call within a few hours to fix a stubborn sink clog. I am very pleased with their work and will not hesitate to recommend or call again if necessary. Thanks!

reviews.author: T-bone Rone
reviews.text: Came out next day. On a Sunday! Very personable, very knowledgeable, quick and reliable. What more could you want? I highly recommend Dickson Plumbing for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Josh Mirrotto
reviews.text: He came out in a crisis on short notice and got us up and running in a few hours. He ran the camera in as many times as he needed to ensure he got it right. Professional and cares about his work. Highly recommend this company!!!

reviews.author: John Kuqali
reviews.text: This plumbing company is 100+++++++ Amazing customer service THE MAN IS AMAZING !!!! HIS WORK SHOULD BE PUT IN THE SMITHSONIAN MUSEUM IF I HAD A PROJECT IN ALASKA I WOULD USE HIM !!!!! HE IS AWESOME

reviews.author: ken wolff
reviews.text: Richard arrived at my home on time. He is very professional and friendly and explained everything that he was doing. Thank you for taking care of our plumbing problem so quickly.

reviews.author: Ron Trostle
reviews.text: Richard was very professional and upfront. He explained the procedures and challenges he faced with the shower installation. I would definitely use Dickson Plumbing in the future.

reviews.author: Susan Newman
reviews.text: Just moved to EC...bought an older home that had been vacant for three years. Called Dickson plumbing and Richard promptly came over, discussed the various issues, sent me a professional quote and set up a date and time to come fix me up. He was LICENSED, on time, professional, and kind. Did what he said he was going to do when he said he was going to do it and did the work per code (inspector involved). I feel like his company is one of the few I can trust. He is now my plumber. Period.

reviews.author: Lynn Hodges
reviews.text: Richard does exceptional work. Always on time, knowledgeable and goes the extra step for his customers. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sandra Hicks
reviews.text: Dickson plumbing is always punctual and does excellent work. This is not the first time Richard has helped me with my plumbing needs and it will not be the last.

reviews.author: Kyle Hume
reviews.text: Great experience on 2 occasions. A sink removal/install and a shower valve replacement. Both were done quick and professionally. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lisa Guyette
reviews.text: Richard and Sam were polite, respectful, and worked quickly to fix the clog. They explained the process and how to prevent it in the future. Very helpful and answered all my questions.

reviews.author: JS Porter Renovations

reviews.author: Marlee Goodhue
reviews.text: It is always a pleasure working with Dickson Plumbing. Very professional, punctual, and over the top service!

reviews.author: Jeff Terry

reviews.author: Yvette Valentine

reviews.author: Jordan Campbell
reviews.text: Great service. Reasonable pricing. I plan to use them for any future plumbing needs. I would recommend.

reviews.text: kitchen sink clogged! they did a good cleaning! no more clogs!! I sure do appreciate them!! I will definitely call them again if needed! Thanks guys!!

reviews.author: A.J. Bohn Jr.
reviews.text: Super clean work, on time,responded immediately to my calls . I used them before and will continue to use them with future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Caasi Suaava (Samoa32)
reviews.text: I am so thankful for these guys! They did a wonderful job installing our new sink, faucet, and garbage disposal. They’re going to be our Plummer for here on out! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Eric

reviews.author: Jannika Boyd

reviews.author: Mariateresa Wills

reviews.text: Friendly and on time, and did the job perfectly. I hope I don't need a plumber again, but if I do these are the only guys i'm gonna call.

reviews.text: On time, very professional, fast, and did exactly what I needed. Will be calling again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Curtis Anderson
reviews.text: The employees were friendly and the installation of the new pipe was quick. I would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: David Prizer
reviews.text: These guys came through, after hours. I sprang a leak under my house, after hours on a Friday evening. I had difficulty getting a response from my regular plumber, but Dickson responded within an hour and completed the task, going under my house, at 8:30 pm and fixing the leak totally. I appreciate the quick and courteous service when it was needed the most. Thanks.

reviews.author: LKGFUN
reviews.text: 7.16.26 Used Dickson Plumbing for Home Warranty repair, this firm are pure professionals. The technician Cody is great to work with and finished my repair in short order. From the call to the office to schedule and completing my repair you will not be disappointed. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!
